categories.name: Climate Science
categories.notes: One course (3 credits).

categories.name: Climate Emergency
categories.notes: One course (3 credits). Forestry students may substitute CONS 210.

categories.name: Elective
categories.notes: One course (3 credits). Cannot double-count a course used for another category.

categories.name: Climate Action
categories.notes: 6 credits total. Two credits from ENVR 201+ENVR 301 or ENVR 302, plus four credits from ENVR 401+GEOG 402 or ENVR 401+ENVR 402.

categories.name: Certificate Requirements
categories.notes: INLB 210 OR 310 (3 credits) plus INLB 220 OR 320 (3 credits), then 9 additional credits of INLB courses or pre-approved related-area courses.

categories.name: Certificate Requirements
categories.notes: Open only to Fraser Valley Institute (FVI) students; complete at least 9 UBC course credits at FVI. Specific courses rotate yearly — see Geography dept. listings.

categories.name: Focused-area Art History courses (300+)
categories.notes: 15 credits of ARTH numbered 300+ in a geographical/chronological/thematic area of focus.

categories.name: Other Art History courses (300+)
categories.notes: 9 credits in ARTH 300+ outside the chosen 15-credit focus area.

categories.name: 400-level Art History seminar
categories.notes: 3 credits in a 400-level ARTH seminar.

categories.name: First Year required courses
categories.notes: Plus 6 credits from CINE 200-level or higher.

categories.name: Second Year required courses
categories.notes: FIPR 333 + FIPR 337 plus 15 credits from listed FIPR 330/399/434–439 and at least 6 Cinema Studies credits from the listed CINE / cross-listed courses.

categories.name: Screenwriting Option (optional)
categories.notes: 6–12 additional credits in CRWR 406/409 by portfolio. CRWR 414 is also listed in the Calendar but is not currently offered.

categories.name: Core LING courses
categories.notes: 6 credits from the listed LING courses.

categories.name: Upper-level LING coursework
categories.notes: 24 additional credits at 300+; up to 6 may be from upper-level courses in related areas (see Linguistics dept).

categories.name: Typical Diploma program
categories.notes: Minimum 30 credits at 300+ in atmospheric science, planned with the Associate Chair. Typical core: ATSC 201, 212, 301, 303, 404, 405; GEOS 300, 304; plus 12 credits from the listed electives. Up to 12 credits exemption for prior coursework; total load not to exceed 42 credits.

categories.name: Individual performance instruction
categories.notes: At least 8 credits of individual performance instruction at the appropriate level.

categories.name: Suitable ensembles
categories.notes: At least 8 credits of suitable ensembles. Orchestral instrumentalists must take MUSC 550 + two small ensembles (MUSC 556–569). Opera students must take MUSC 539. Pianists must take MUSC 561.

categories.name: Core courses
categories.notes: Non-Forestry students may substitute GEOS 270 + GEOS 373 for NRES 241 + NRES 341.

categories.name: Elective courses
categories.notes: 6 credits from the approved electives list (maintained on the GEM Certificate website — not enumerated here).

categories.name: Required courses
categories.notes: ECON 221 or ECON 421 may substitute for POLI 310. ECON 325 may substitute for POLI 380. A 75% minimum in POLI 310/380/381 is required to register in POLI 482.

categories.name: Elective
categories.notes: 3 credits of any of the listed FREN courses.

categories.name: Electives
categories.notes: Two 3-credit electives from any two of: Counselling Psychology & Career Planning (CNPS 363/427, EDCP 497); Healthy Living (FNH 355; Kinesiology dept electives — see Calendar); Relationship (FMST 314, FMST 316, SOCI 312); First Nations (EDCP 362).

categories.name: UBC required courses
categories.notes: Three UBC courses (EDCP 362B section + EDCP 304 + EDCP 492 + EDCP 498) plus two KPU courses (FSDP 9012, 9017, 9007, 9019, 9004 — KPU codes not validated against UBC course list).

categories.name: Year 1 mandatory courses (2025+ cohort)
categories.notes: BIOL 112 + (BIOL 153 OR 155) + (CHEM 111 OR 121) + CHEM 123 + WRDS 150 + first-term math + second-term math + PHAR 180 + 3 credits elective.

categories.name: Year 2 mandatory courses (2025+ cohort)
categories.notes: Plus 3 credits elective. BIOL 300 may substitute for STAT 200 for students who meet the prerequisites.

categories.name: Year 3 mandatory courses
categories.notes: Honours students take an additional 3 upper-level elective credits in Year 3.

categories.name: Year 4 — B.P.Sc. (default Course-based) option electives
categories.notes: 30 upper-level elective credits, of which no more than 12 may be outside the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences.

categories.name: Year 4 — Experiential Option: Research (alternative)
categories.notes: PHAR 485 (15) plus 15 elective credits (max 3 outside the Faculty).

categories.name: Year 4 — Experiential Option: Practicum (alternative)
categories.notes: PHAR 495 (15) plus 15 elective credits (max 3 outside the Faculty).

categories.name: Year 4 — Experiential Option with Honours (alternative)
categories.notes: PHAR 485 + PHAR 491 + 12 elective credits (max 3 outside the Faculty). Requires 80% cumulative average and a defended honours thesis.

categories.name: Writing Requirement
categories.notes: WRDS 150 (or approved equivalent).

categories.name: Upper-level Kinesiology credits
categories.notes: Minimum 36 upper-level (300+) credits in KIN. Specific requirements vary by Option (Neuromechanical & Physiological Sciences / Social & Behavioural Sciences / Multi-disciplinary Science).

categories.name: Upper-level credits (total across all subjects)
categories.notes: Minimum 48 credits at the 300+ level across the entire degree.

categories.name: Minor in Commerce — required courses
categories.notes: Five 3-credit COMR courses plus one of COMR 398 or COMR 458. Admission requires ECON 101+102 and one of MATH 100/102/104/120/180/184.

Minor in Educational and Counselling Psychology and Special Education — electives

categories.name: Minor in Nutritional Science — electives

categories.notes: Engineering economics and project management (min 3 credits); Humanities and social sciences electives (min 6); Oral and written communication (min 6); Health and safety; Professionalism/ethics/equity/law (min 2); Impact of technology on society and Sustainable development (min 3 combined for those two).
